missions.name: Dead Stock Detection
missions.query: Identify products with stock count greater than 120 days old in the inventory table.

missions.name: Sizing Anomalies
missions.query: Find products where the size range is greater than 20% of the total stock count across all sizes.

missions.name: Supplier Delay Analysis
missions.query: Identify suppliers with an average lead time greater than 30 days and less than 90% on-time rate over the past 6 months.

missions.name: Reorder Point Breaches
missions.query: Find products where the stock count has fallen below the reorder point and the last restocked date is more than 60 days ago.

missions.name: Low-Margin Products
missions.query: Identify products with a retail price less than 150% of the unit cost and more than 10 units sold in the past month.

missions.name: Channel-Specific Sales
missions.query: Find sales events where the channel is 'online' and the units sold are more than 50% of the total units sold for the product in the past quarter.

missions.name: Supplier Concentration Risk
missions.query: Identify suppliers with more than 30% of the total products and an average lead time greater than 20 days.

missions.name: Seasonal Demand Analysis
missions.query: Find products with a sales volume greater than 80% of the total sales for the product in the past year and a seasonality coefficient greater than 1.5.
